2) API key location — the trial key lives in the Console under "API Keys" > "Trial" (I included the preflight checklist attached).
3) SDK mismatch — our quickstart uses sdk v0.8; old versions will fail during handshake.

If you'd like, we can:
- Rebook a 30-min slot tomorrow or next week (I included a few options below).
- Do an async preflight via email — if you can paste a brief cURL output or the client error we can triage without a call.

- Thu 1 Jul 09:00–09:30
- Thu 1 Jul 11:00–11:30
- Mon 5 Jul 14:00–14:30

Please let me know which works and whether you want Vanessa to bring a sample firewall BCP that we can hand to your network team. Attaching checklist again.

Sergio
